claim: Classique menu €165, Signature €195; wine pairings €95/€120; 20 seats, one sitting per service; deposit required; confirm 48h before; all produce sourced within 500km; MARIA has 91 plates
quote: Seven-course tasting menu. Classique: €165. Signature: €195. The menu showcases suppliers' work and includes a visit to MARIA.

claim: JAN holds 1 Michelin star in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide France
quote: JAN is a One Star MICHELIN Guide restaurant in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide France.

claim: 7-course format; specific dishes including mullet ceviche, bobotie, biltong; 120+ wine references; stone walls and exposed beams atmosphere; restaurant near Port Lympia
quote: Mullet ceviche with Nice seawater, dill, lemongrass, and puffed local spelt. The wine list holds over 120 references, including South African selections.

claim: TripAdvisor rating 4.7/5 with 1,752 reviews; #46 of 2,155 restaurants in Nice; typical dining duration 3-3.5 hours; minority of reviews flag slow service and lukewarm dishes
quote: 4.7 of 5 bubbles (1,752 reviews). Ranking: #46 of 2,155 restaurants in Nice.

claim: Google rating 4.8/5 with 1,132 reviews; address 12 Rue Lascaris; phone +33 4 97 19 32 23; vegetarian and gluten-free options available on request
quote: Google: 4.8/5 (1,132 reviews). Address: 12 Rue Lascaris, Nice. Vegetarian options available.

claim: Gault&Millau 15/20 'Remarkable Restaurant'; chef praised for 'uncompromising imagination' and 'respect for the product'; signature dishes include tuna with sago/rooibos and scallops with caviar and lemon meringue
quote: Rating: 15/20 (Remarkable Restaurant). The Gault&Millau review notes his 'respect for the product' and 'uncompromising imagination'.

claim: Dinner Tuesday-Saturday 19:00-22:00; lunch Friday-Saturday 12:00-14:00; closed Sunday and Monday
quote: Open for dinner Tuesday to Saturday 19:00-22:00, and for lunch Friday and Saturday between 12:00-14:00.

claim: Stone walls, exposed beams, antique furniture, white tablecloths, candles; open kitchen visible from dining room; staff present each dish verbally
quote: Discreetly classy setting with perfectly polished silverware, crisp white table cloths and candles throughout. Diners can observe the kitchen directly.

claim: TripAdvisor reviewer describes MARIA cheese room as unmissable, calling it romantic and a highlight of the evening
quote: You could skip dinner and stay in this beautifully decorated room with candles. A must do if you love cheese. Super romantic.

claim: MARIA named after chef's grandmother and his mother, both named Maria; the room contains portraits of women in the chef's family; chandelier from Paris Metro; South African gin bar on mezzanine
quote: MARIA honors the women in Chef Jan-Hendrik's life. A chandelier sourced from the Paris Metro. A South African Gin Bar in the mezzanine seating area.

claim: Smart casual dress code; no shorts, tank tops, or sandals; the atmosphere is elegant without being stiff
quote: Smart casual clothing is appropriate. Avoid shorts, tank tops, T-shirts alone. The atmosphere is 'unpretentious' — formality is less important than basic respect.

claim: JAN wines are blended from grapes grown at Org de Rac in the Swartland; white is Chenin Blanc/Roussanne/Verdelho; red is Shiraz/Mourvèdre/Grenache/Verdelho
quote: JAN white is a blend of Chenin Blanc, Roussanne and Verdelho. The red expresses Shiraz, Mourvèdre, Grenache and Verdelho. Sourced from Org de Rac in the Swartland region.

claim: Seasonal dishes include summer truffle with ancient grains, fish from Nice Harbour with apple and chorizo, and sago pudding with lychee/rose/raspberry
quote: Signature dishes include 'summer truffle with ancient grains' and 'fish from the Nice Harbor with apple and chorizo.' Desserts feature 'sago pudding or ice cream combined in a meringue with flavors of litchi, rose, and raspberry.'

claim: Restaurant philosophy is 'honest food inspired by local produce from the markets of the South of France'; MARIA features an open kitchen and communal table for 8-18 guests
quote: Honest food inspired by local produce from the markets of the South of France. MARIA features vintage Baccarat chandeliers, all white interiors and natural wood.

claim: Jan Hendrik grew up in Mpumalanga, South Africa; became the first South African chef to earn a Michelin star in France; has authored three cookbooks and opened Klein JAN at Tswalu Kalahari
quote: He achieved a historic milestone: becoming the first South African chef to earn a Michelin star. He has authored three bestselling cookbooks and opened Restaurant Klein JAN at Tswalu Kalahari.
